title: Joint Embedding with Dynamic Integration network (JEDI-net)
abstract: arXiv:2610.17314v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep learning has become the dominant form of machine learning due in part, to its ability to automatically engineer complex meta features from data. However, even deep learning features can perform erratically because of unobserved latent factors. incorporating latent factor information explicitly, can improve performance by letting the model alter its behavior based on such inferred factors. Because neural networks often capture such complexity inherently, external clustering of the original feature space offers limited benefit. clustering observations by feature importance profiles, rather than raw features, offers a principled way to uncover latent structure, since observations with similar importance patterns may share predictive dynamics. translated_title: 动态集成联合嵌入网络
translated_abstract: 深度学习已成为机器学习的主流形式，部分原因在于其能够从数据中自动构建复杂的元特征。然而，即使是深度学习特征，也可能因未观测到的潜在因素而表现不稳定。显式地融入潜在因素信息，可以让模型根据这些推断出的因素调整自身行为，从而提升性能。由于神经网络通常内在地捕捉这类复杂性，对原始特征空间进行外部聚类所能带来的收益有限。而按照特征重要性分布（而非原始特征本身）对观测样本进行聚类，则为揭示潜在结构提供了一种有原则的方法，因为具有相似重要性模式的观测样本可能共享相似的预测动态。在先前的工作中，我们提出了带聚类与解释的特征导向表示方法（FORCE），并证明该方法能够显著提升神经网络的性能。在本文中，我们提出……（摘要原文在此处截断，未完整）
tldr: 该论文提出动态集成联合嵌入网络，其核心创新在于不依赖原始特征而是依据特征重要性分布进行聚类以显式建模潜在因素，从而提升深度神经网络在面对未观测潜在因素时的性能与稳定性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes JEDI-net, whose key innovation is clustering observations by feature importance profiles rather than raw features to explicitly incorporate latent factor information, thereby improving the performance and robustness of deep neural networks.
